player_prompt.intro:
Wai Mwari {player_id} muWild Tic Tac Toe.
Pa turn yako, unogona kuisa 'X' kana 'O' muSquare riri pamhi.
Unowina kana wakabatanidza marudzi matatu ane simbo (X kana O) mukati.
Unogona kushanda na simbo zvigumba.
Chagua mikando yako kwa fomati '[X 4]' kuisa X pakati.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomati ya mikando isingakorekte. Tsunga '[X 4]' kana '[O 2]' fomati.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Nhamba yefoni isiriyo: {cell}. Inofanira kuva pakati pe 0 ne 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Kufamba kusina kukodzera. Cell {cell} yatova nemunhu aripo.

game_action.placed: Mwari {player_id} akaweka simbo yake ({mark}) muCEL yu{cell}
